title: Persona Generators: Generating Diverse Synthetic Personas at Scale

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the diversity of LLM-generated persona populations across multiple simulated psychometric questionnaires using geometric diversity metrics (e.g., support coverage, convex hull volume, dispersion) to quantify the under-representation of long-tail, non-WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, Democratic), and outlier behaviors.

Measuring mode collapse and behavioral homogenization in synthetic personas by comparing their response embeddings against an ideal quasi-random distribution using KL divergence and pairwise distance metrics to detect clustering around typical, average, or stereotypical profiles.
